author: claude

generation.prompt:
Pixel art WALK CYCLE sprite sheet of the EXACT same character as attached image 1 — a finished pixel-art sprite.
Copy it pixel for pixel in style: same very large chunky pixels, same 16-colour palette, same dark outline,
same proportions (about 4 heads tall), same face. Short pink-red hair, a red mono-eye visor helmet with a single antenna horn on the image-left side, red armour with a spiked shoulder shield on the image-right shoulder, a black tubular power cable at the waist, red armoured skirt plates and heavy red boots, a grey machine gun held in the image-left hand.
Keep decoration as simple as image 1 — do not add new details. Image 3 is only a colour and face reference; do not copy its painterly style.

Sheet layout: portrait canvas 2160 x 3840, 6 frames in a 3 x 2 grid (cell 720 x 1920), read left to right, top to bottom.
In every cell the character is the same size (about 125 pixels tall on the sprite's own pixel grid, each sprite pixel
drawn as a crisp 13 x 13 square), centred horizontally, with both feet on the same baseline near the bottom of the cell.
Every frame faces the same direction as described below. Hard edges only: no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, no dithering noise.
Transparent background. No grid lines, no cell borders, no numbers, no labels, no text, no ground, no shadow, no motion lines, no extra characters.
Side three-quarter view walking toward the viewer's right, walking in place (the character does not travel across the cell).

LEGS — follow attached image 2 exactly, cell by cell (dark navy = the NEAR leg, the one closer to the viewer;
grey = the FAR leg). Do not copy image 2's shapes or colours, only where each leg and foot is:
frame 1 = contact: NEAR leg reaches forward, heel down; FAR leg stretched back, only its toe touching.
frame 2 = down: weight on the NEAR leg, knee slightly bent, body 1 pixel lower; FAR foot lifting off behind.
frame 3 = passing: NEAR leg straight under the body; FAR leg swings forward past it with the knee lifted; body 1 pixel higher.
frame 4 = contact, the MIRROR of frame 1: FAR leg reaches forward, heel down; NEAR leg stretched BACK, only its toe touching.
frame 5 = down: weight on the FAR leg; NEAR foot lifting off behind; body 1 pixel lower.
frame 6 = passing: FAR leg straight under the body; NEAR leg swings forward past it with the knee lifted; body 1 pixel higher.
Frames 1 and 4 must look clearly different: in frame 1 the near leg is in front, in frame 4 the near leg is behind.
Arms swing opposite to the legs (near arm back when the near leg is forward). Head height changes by at most 1 sprite pixel
except the rise and fall above. The loop 6 -> 1 must be seamless.

cleaned.tool: polos0117.github.io dot.html (rust/dot-core — book-atelier 파이썬 도구와 같은 셈)

why: 사용자 "삼국지는 빼고 공방별로 2개씩 더 만들어줘"(2026-10-28) — 이 공방 그림 중 내가 고른 한 장. book 의 4K 와 같은 길(2160×3840 · 원본 격자 그대로 · 칸 192×256 · dot 0.5), 본보기는 book 앨리스 4K 정지 6배
touched: 4~6칸을 1~3칸의 거울 반 주기로 다시 만들었다(2026-10-28) — 받은 원본은 여섯 칸 모두 가까운 다리가 앞이라(뒤 반 주기가 거울이 아님) 걸을 때 뒷걸음처럼 보였다(사용자 "백스텝"). 다시 받은 원본(gen2)도 같아서, 1~3칸에서 다리(빨강·살색·무릎 아래 검정, x 46~139 · y 165 아래)만 x 축 92 를 중심으로 뒤집어 4~6칸에 넣고 총은 그대로 위에 두었다. 오르내림·빠르기는 그 시트로 다시 셈(tools 와 같은 dot.wasm bob 2·stride)
